figurative_meaning_bn: বৎসরের সকল সময়েই জন্মে এমন ফসল
figurative_meaning_en: A crop that grows in all seasons of the year
example_sentences_in_bangla: বারোমেসে ফসল হিসেবে বেগুনের মতো উদ্ভিদ খুবই লাভজনক।
এই অঞ্চলে বারোমেসে ধান চাষ করে কৃষকরা সারা বছর আয় করেন।
example_sentences_in_english: Eggplant is a profitable crop as it grows year-round.
Farmers in this region cultivate year-round rice to earn income throughout the year.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali agriculture, referencing crops like brinjal (eggplant) that thrive without seasonal dependency, reflecting the agrarian lifestyle in Bengal.
note: Often exemplified with 'বারোমেসে বেগুন' to denote brinjal's perennial growth.
